fields.question: How do I book a service?
fields.answer: Choose your service and area, then send the booking form, message us on WhatsApp or call +91 90374 02356. We confirm the visit time with you before the technician comes.

fields.question: Which areas do you cover?
fields.answer: Kannur (Kannur Town, Thalassery, Mattanur, Panoor), Thrissur (Thrissur Town, Guruvayoor, Irinjalakuda, Kunnamkulam, Chalakudy) and Kochi. If your area isn’t listed, send your location on WhatsApp and we’ll tell you straight away if a technician can reach you.

fields.question: Will I know the cost before work starts?
fields.answer: Yes. The technician inspects the problem, explains what’s wrong and shares the quote before any work begins.

fields.question: Which AC and appliance brands do you service?
Can I book on WhatsApp?
fields.answer: Yes. Message us on WhatsApp with your service and area — you can share photos or a short video of the problem — and we’ll confirm a visit slot.

fields.question: How often should an AC be serviced in {town}?
How much does AC service cost?

fields.answer: Yes. We check for leaks first, then refill to the correct pressure.

fields.answer: Send the booking form on this page, message us on WhatsApp — your service and town are filled in for you — or call +91 90374 02356. We confirm the visit time before the technician comes.

fields.question: Do you cover Thalassery, Mattanur and Panoor?
fields.answer: Yes. Along with Kannur Town, we cover Thalassery, Mattanur and Panoor.

fields.answer: Send your location on WhatsApp and we’ll tell you straight away if a technician can reach you.
